parts.text: I worry about conditions in the field, such as when radio coverage is patchy and reports from drones arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all. Drones sometimes restart in flight after a software fault and carry on, and batteries drain faster in cold and wind than planned. Before and during a flight, things happen outside our control, and several dispatchers plan at the same time for the same busy sites and popular drones.
